steps.title: Stamp the workshop template version on the requirements page in Confluence
sop: Open the team space in Confluence and click Create to start the requirements page
Select the BA playbook workshop template from the template picker
Confirm the template version with the Product Owner before applying it
Type the agreed template version into the page header and publish
Done when the published page header shows the agreed template version
verify: Open the requirements page in Confluence and read the page header
Pass when the header shows the template version the Product Owner agreed

steps.title: Facilitate the elicitation workshop with stakeholders
sop: Send a calendar invite from Outlook to the business stakeholders and SMEs named on the intake
Attach the Confluence requirements page link to the invite as pre-read
Run the workshop walking each agenda topic and capturing requirements as they are raised
Type notes live into the workshop section of the requirements page in Confluence
Done when the workshop has run and the live notes are saved in Confluence
verify: Open the workshop notes on the requirements page in Confluence
Compare the attendee names against the stakeholders named on the invite
Pass when the notes show the session ran with the named stakeholders present

steps.title: Save the attendee list with decisions in Confluence
sop: Open the workshop page in Confluence and click Edit
Paste the attendee list into an Attendees table with name and role columns
Enter each decision as a row in a Decisions table with owner and date
Add a note stating the minimum 3-year retention and publish the page
Done when the published versioned page holds both tables with the retention note
verify: Open the workshop page in Confluence and read both tables
Pass when the attendee list with the decision log is complete on the versioned page

steps.title: Assign a unique ID to every captured requirement in Jira
sop: Open the project backlog in Jira and filter to the requirement issues from the workshop
Enter the next sequential requirement ID in the Requirement ID field on each issue
Tick off each requirement on the workshop notes list as its ID is assigned
Done when every captured requirement issue carries a unique ID
verify: Run the workshop requirement filter in Jira with the Requirement ID column shown
Sort by Requirement ID and scan for blanks or duplicates
Pass when a unique ID is confirmed on each

steps.title: Record the business rationale on each requirement in Jira
sop: Run the workshop requirement filter in Jira and open each issue
Type the business rationale from the workshop decisions into the Description
Cite the driving stakeholder or decision row from the Confluence notes
Done when no requirement issue lacks a written business rationale
verify: Open the workshop requirement filter in Jira and read each Description
Pass when a business rationale is seen on each

steps.title: Write INVEST-compliant story text on each story in Jira
sop: Open the backlog in Jira and open each workshop story
Rewrite the summary and description in As-a / I-want / So-that form
Check the text against each INVEST letter and split any story that fails Small
Done when every story reads as independent, valuable and testable per INVEST
verify: Sample at least 5 workshop stories from the backlog in Jira
Read each against the INVEST checklist
Pass when INVEST-compliant text is confirmed

steps.title: Record Given/When/Then acceptance criteria on each story in Jira
sop: Open each story in Jira and click into the Acceptance Criteria field
Write at least one testable Given/When/Then scenario per criterion
Add the Needs Refinement label to any story still missing criteria
Done when every story shows criteria or the Needs Refinement flag
verify: Filter ready stories in Jira excluding the Needs Refinement label
Read the Acceptance Criteria field on each
Pass when 100% carry Given/When/Then criteria

steps.title: Set the MoSCoW priority on each story in Jira
sop: Open the backlog in Jira and add the MoSCoW field as a visible column
Set Must, Should, Could or Won't on each story per the workshop decisions
Confirm contested priorities with the Product Owner before saving
Done when no story shows a blank MoSCoW value
verify: Filter the backlog in Jira by empty MoSCoW field
Pass when the filter returns zero stories

steps.title: Name a business owner on each story in Jira
sop: Open each committed story in Jira
Enter the sponsoring stakeholder in the Business Owner field
Take the name from the attendee list on the Confluence workshop page
Done when no committed story lacks a named business owner
verify: Filter committed stories in Jira with the Business Owner column shown
Pass when a named business owner is seen on each

steps.title: Reconcile the story count against the traceability matrix in Confluence
sop: Open the traceability matrix page in Confluence
Count the requirement rows and note each mapped Jira story key
Run the workshop story filter in Jira and compare its count to the matrix
Add missing rows or stories until the two counts match
Done when the delta is 0
verify: Recount the matrix rows in Confluence against the Jira story filter count
Pass when a 0 delta with no orphan stories is confirmed

steps.title: Log open questions as req-open-item issues in Jira
sop: Read the open-questions section of the workshop notes in Confluence
Click Create in Jira and raise one req-open-item issue per question
Set an owner and a due date on each issue before saving
Comment the parked-or-pursue disposition on each item
Done when every open question is an issue carrying a disposition
verify: Filter the req-open-item label in Jira
Pass when an owner plus due date is seen on each

steps.title: Flag pricing or underwriting requirements as high-impact in Jira
sop: Run the workshop requirement filter in Jira and read each summary for pricing or underwriting scope
Add the high-impact label to each matching requirement
Comment on each tagging the second SME and the Solution Architect for review
Done when all pricing or underwriting requirements carry the flag
verify: Filter the high-impact flag in Jira
Pass when every pricing or underwriting requirement flagged is seen

steps.title: Escalate stories above 8 points for feasibility sign-off in Jira
sop: Filter stories above 8 points or spanning multiple systems in Jira
Comment on each requesting Product Owner feasibility sign-off before commit
Link the escalation comment thread to the story so it is traceable
Done when each oversized story shows the escalation recorded pre-commit
verify: Open stories above 8 points in Jira
Pass when the feasibility escalation recorded pre-commit is seen

steps.title: Record the Product Owner sign-off on the workshop notes in Confluence
sop: Share the notes page link with the Product Owner and request approval
Open the notes page in Confluence once the approval reply arrives
Add a sign-off line naming the Product Owner with the approval date
Done when the dated sign-off appears on the notes page
verify: Open the notes page in Confluence
Pass when the dated Product Owner sign-off is seen

steps.title: Collect the versioned architecture diagram in Confluence
sop: Open space ARCH in Confluence and browse to the epic's architecture page
Locate the current C4 diagram attachment for the release
Confirm the attachment carries a version tag and copy it to the evidence folder
Done when the collected diagram carries a version tag
verify: Open space ARCH in Confluence and open the architecture page
Pass when the diagram with its version tag is seen

steps.title: Collect the code-review record for every merged PR in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the repository in GitHub Enterprise and filter Pull requests to merged PRs linked to the epic
Open each PR's Reviews tab and capture the approval record
Save one review record per PR into the evidence folder
Done when each collected record shows 2 approvers
verify: Open each merged PR in GitHub Enterprise and read its Reviews tab
Pass when 2 approvers are confirmed on every review record

steps.title: Collect the CI test-result set for the epic in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the Actions tab of the repository in GitHub Actions
Open the latest run for each epic branch and download the test-result artifacts
Note the pass rate and coverage figure from each run summary
Done when the collected set shows the pass rate with the coverage figure
verify: Open the CI runs in GitHub Actions and read each run summary
Pass when the pass rate plus coverage figure is seen

steps.title: Export the release risk log in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Open the release risk register in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
Filter the log to the current release and click Export
Save the export file with its generation date into the evidence folder
Done when the export is dated inside the release window
verify: Open the saved export in the GRC platform evidence folder
Check the generation date against the release window
Pass when it is confirmed dated within the window

steps.title: Record the source permalink on each evidence item in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Open the epic's evidence list in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
Open each row and paste the source permalink into the Source Link field
Reject any item with a blank link back to its collector
Done when every evidence row saves with a working permalink
verify: Open the evidence rows in the GRC platform
Click each Source Link and confirm it resolves
Pass when a working permalink is followed on each

steps.title: Record the issue key on each evidence item in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Open the epic's evidence list in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
Open each row and enter the related Jira issue key in the Issue Key field
Copy each key from the linked story or epic in Jira to avoid typos
Done when no evidence item lacks its Jira key
verify: Read the evidence rows in the GRC platform
Pass when a Jira key is seen on each

steps.title: Exclude evidence dated outside the release window in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Open the evidence list in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC) and sort by item date
Compare each date to the feature-cut and RC-freeze boundaries
Remove every item dated outside feature-cut to RC-freeze
Done when only in-window evidence remains in the list
verify: Sort the evidence list by date in the GRC platform
Pass when none is found outside the window

steps.title: Reconcile the evidence count against the assurance checklist in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Open the assurance checklist for the epic in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
Count merged PRs in GitHub Enterprise and add the 3 fixed artifacts for the expected total
Compare the expected total to the evidence rows in the list
Chase collectors for any shortfall until the counts match
Done when the delta is 0
verify: Recompute the expected count of merged PRs plus 3 fixed artifacts in the GRC platform
Pass when a 0 delta is confirmed

steps.title: Upload the bundle under the epic folder in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Open the epic folder in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
Upload the evidence bundle to /assurance/<epic-key>/ with a version label
Set the folder retention policy to 3 years per NYDFS
Done when the versioned bundle sits under the epic folder with 3-year retention
verify: Open the epic folder in the GRC platform
Pass when the versioned bundle with immutable timestamp is seen

steps.title: Diff the bundle against the prior release bundle in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Open the prior release bundle beside the new bundle in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
Run the pre and post comparison across evidence types and coverage figures
Investigate any missing mandatory type or coverage drop before proceeding
Done when all mandatory types are present with no coverage regression
verify: Read the comparison report in the GRC platform
Pass when no missing type or regression is confirmed

steps.title: Link the CHG record to the evidence bundle in ServiceNow ITSM
sop: Open the release CHG record in ServiceNow ITSM
Paste the evidence bundle URL into the related links with the epic key plus release tag
Copy the CHG URL onto the bundle cover sheet in the GRC platform
Done when the CHG URL is on the cover sheet
verify: Open the CHG record in ServiceNow ITSM
Pass when the link to the evidence bundle is followed

steps.title: Log missing or stale evidence as an SDLC-Exception in Jira
sop: List every missing or stale item found during reconciliation
Click Create in Jira and raise one SDLC-Exception per gap with its disposition
Assign the Engineering Manager as owner with the 10-business-day remediation due date
Done when every gap ticket shows the owner and remediation date
verify: Open the SDLC-Exception tickets in Jira
Pass when the disposition with the Engineering Manager as owner is seen

steps.title: Record the Tech Lead sign-off on the evidence bundle in GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC)
sop: Send the bundle link to the Tech Lead and request approval before the assurance gate
Open the bundle record in the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC) once approved
Enter the Tech Lead name with the approval date in the sign-off field
Done when the dated sign-off is saved on the bundle
verify: Open the bundle in the GRC platform
Pass when the dated Tech Lead sign-off is seen

steps.title: Create a story under the epic for each scoped requirement in Jira
sop: Open the epic in Jira and expand its child issues panel
Click Create child issue once per requirement on the intake list
Name each story after its requirement so the mapping stays obvious
Done when every scoped requirement has a story under the epic
verify: Open the epic in Jira and count the child stories
Pass when one story per scoped requirement is counted

steps.title: Enter the user-story statement in the story description in Jira
sop: Open each story under the epic in Jira
Write the As-a / I-want / So-that statement into the Description
Save and move to the next story on the epic's child list
Done when no story Description is empty
verify: Sample stories under the epic in Jira and read each Description
Pass when a user-story statement is seen in each description

steps.title: Record Given/When/Then acceptance criteria on each story in Jira
sop: Filter sprint-bound stories under the epic in Jira
Open each and write testable Given/When/Then scenarios in the Acceptance Criteria field
Check each criterion states an observable outcome a tester can run
Done when no sprint-bound story lacks criteria
verify: Filter sprint-bound stories in Jira
Pass when 100% carry Given/When/Then criteria

steps.title: Set the Epic Link on each story in Jira
sop: Run a project filter in Jira showing the new stories with the Epic Link column
Set the Epic Link field on each story missing it
Done when no story is unlinked
verify: Run an unlinked-story filter in Jira
Pass when it returns zero results

steps.title: Link the SME source docs on each story in Jira
sop: Open each story in Jira and click Link then Web link
Paste the Confluence SME source page URL with a readable label
Repeat for every SME doc the story draws on
Done when every story references its SME docs
verify: Open stories in Jira and click each SME link
Pass when the linked SME source docs are followed

steps.title: Reconcile story count against the requirements register in Jira
sop: Open the requirements register page in Confluence and count its rows
Run the epic story filter in Jira and compare the count
Map each unmatched register row to a story or raise the missing story
Done when 0 unmapped items remain
verify: Compare the register total in Confluence to the story count in Jira
Pass when 0 unmapped items is confirmed

steps.title: Log ambiguous requirements as Clarification sub-tasks in Jira
sop: Read each story in Jira and flag wording a developer could read two ways
Click Create sub-task on each flagged story and label it Clarification
Set an owner and a due date on each sub-task
Set each sub-task to block the story's Ready for Dev transition
Done when each ambiguity has a blocking Clarification sub-task
verify: Open the Clarification sub-tasks in Jira
Pass when an owner plus due date is seen on each

steps.title: Escalate Clarifications aging past 5 business days as an SDLC-Exception in Jira
sop: Run a filter in Jira for open Clarification sub-tasks created over 5 business days ago
Click Create and raise one SDLC-Exception per aged Clarification
Link the exception to the sub-task and flag the Product Owner as approver
Done when no Clarification ages unescalated
verify: Filter Clarifications older than 5 business days in Jira
Pass when a linked SDLC-Exception is seen on each

steps.title: Retain the requirements page history for the project lifetime plus 24 months in Confluence
sop: Open the requirements page in Confluence and open Page history
Confirm version history is intact in the team space with no deletions
Add a note on the page stating the project-lifetime-plus-24-months retention
Done when the retention note is published on the page
verify: Open the page in Confluence and its Page history
Pass when version history with the retention note is seen

steps.title: Confirm 100 percent of sprint-bound stories carry approved criteria in Jira
sop: Open the sprint on the Backlog view in Jira
Open each committed story and read its acceptance criteria
Send back any story whose criteria are missing or unapproved
Done when no sprint-bound story lacks approved testable criteria
verify: Filter the sprint stories in Jira
Pass when every story shows approved acceptance criteria

steps.title: Record the Product Owner sign-off on each agreed story in Jira
sop: Open each agreed story in Jira before it moves to Ready for Dev
Review the statement, criteria and priority one final time
Add a dated sign-off comment approving the story
Done when each story shows the dated approval
verify: Open the agreed stories in Jira and read the comments
Pass when the dated Product Owner sign-off is seen on each

Open the Actions tab and check the last merge kicked off the docs job
Done when each merge to develop regenerates the reference
verify: Open recent merge runs on the Actions tab in GitHub Actions
Pass when the reference regenerated each time is seen

sop: Open the OpenAPI spec file in the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Add the security scheme reference on each endpoint missing one
Commit the change on the docs branch and push
Done when no endpoint lacks a documented auth scheme
verify: Sample endpoints in the spec in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when an auth scheme is seen on each

steps.title: Document the request schema for every endpoint in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the OpenAPI spec file in the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Add the request body schema on each endpoint missing one
Commit the change on the docs branch and push
Done when no endpoint lacks a request schema
verify: Sample endpoints in the spec in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when a request schema is seen on each

steps.title: Document the response schema for every endpoint in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the OpenAPI spec file in the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Add the response schema per status code on each endpoint missing one
Commit the change on the docs branch and push

verify: Sample endpoints in the spec in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when a response schema is seen on each

steps.title: Document the error codes for every endpoint in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the OpenAPI spec file in the repository in GitHub Enterprise

verify: Sample endpoints in the spec in GitHub Enterprise

verify: Read the docs-sync stage output in GitHub Actions

steps.title: Log undocumented endpoints as DOC-Gap tickets in Jira
sop: Take each undocumented endpoint from the docs-sync diff output

Assign the Software Engineer as owner and set the fix-by-release-cut due date
Done when every ticket has a fix-by-release-cut SLA
verify: Open the DOC-Gap tickets in Jira
Pass when the Software Engineer as owner with the release-cut SLA is seen

steps.title: Publish the doc bundle tagged with the release version in Confluence

Move each superseded bundle page under the Archive parent instead of deleting

steps.title: Confirm the ADR link is attached to the Design Gate issue in Jira

sop: Copy the decision comment text from the gate issue in Jira
